transcript.answer: `ToolRegistry.execute` in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`. Issue #138 (closed) specified wrapping the executor call and `normalizeToolResponse` in a `try/catch` inside `execute`. If the executor throws, `execute` logs the tool name and error at error level. It then returns a resolved `ToolResponse` with a fixed sentence naming the tool, instead of letting the turn fail. I read this in the issue text, not in the code, so I did not check the merged implementation.

judgements.reason: The answer names ToolRegistry.execute in src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts, not createCrashGuard/withCrashGuard in apps/api/src/tools/toolCrashGuard.ts.
